description: Get one Campaign by campaign_id (id, name, owner, status). Open, park, resume, close, and reassign_owner stay on campaign. Prefer this over campaign action get. Read-only: does not advance the unread cursor. REST: GET /v1/campaigns/{id}. Idempotent.

campaign_id.description: Campaign (a named workstream in this Space) to use; omit for the Space's default Campaign. Ids come from list_campaigns.

name: get_campaign
title: Get campaign
